parse.title: Enemy Mechanics
parse.text:
Some enemies have abilities with a cost on them which may disable effects from certain units.

Enemy Type Effects Counters First Encounter
Shielded Enemies Will appear with a set amount of shield, the shield will be depleted by one point every hit.
  • Hard Counter: Multi-hit units, and Shatter units will shred shields.
  • Soft Counter: Inhuman also shred these via his ability. The thing is, they return back after some time!
  • Challenge: Shield Enemies
  • Shiganshinu District, Act 4 (Wave 15)
Tank enemies Appearing with a white glow over their model, they take slightly reduced damage overall.

Any non-damaging effect still works at full effect. However, Inhuman's ability temporarily nullifies the effect!

  • First Debut: Challenge: Tank Enemies
  • Story Debut: Marine's Ford (Marine Flagbearer)
Fire enemies Will move faster than normal enemies and cause ice units to deal less damage. They also happen to be immune of slows and stuns.
  • Other units that can do effects other than slows and stuns (especially Freeze).
  • Dazai may remove that trait, for them to be able to get stunned or slowed for awhile.
 Magic Town, Act 2 (Wave 10)
Ice enemies Will take less damage from normal units.
  • Fire-aligned units deal THRICE the damage on these types of enemies.
  • Anyone witb a burn will also suffice, as the effect in question has Fire attribute (even if their attribute isn't even Fire , meaning units like Shinobi (Eternal) will also counter those enemies very well!
  • Inhuman may remove that trait for non-Fire aligned units to deal usual damage, but will remove the intended counter for awhile.
 Magic Town, Act 4 (Wave 10)
Regen Enemies Will regenerate health when damaged. Ashborn, Inhuman's ability, or units that deal bleeding damage will temporarily nullify its effects. Snowy Town, Act 4 (Wave 10)
Flying Enemies Ignores ground units and can only be hit by hill units and hybrid unit. High DPS hill units or Hybrid ground units. Or Inhuman's ability can nullify their trait for Ground units to be able to hit them. Hollow World, Act 1 (Wave 10)
Armored Enemies Full AoE units deal half the damage against these units.
  • All other units deal damage regularly against them. And Full AoE effect characters still affect them at full duration (e.g. Shadowgirl (Time Traveller) or Frost Navy (Blue Pigeon)).
  • The same intended nerf can be nullified for awhile by Inhuman's ability.
  • First Debut: Witch City Portals
  • Story Debut: Virtual Dungeon, Act 4 (Wave 10)
Burst Enemies They spawn really fast, but slow down as they get closer to your base.
  • Don't place your units close to the spawn area.
  • The same intended nerf can be nullified for awhile by Inhuman's ability.
  • First Debut: Frozen Abyss (Holiday Event 2024)
